sloka: कच्चिद्धारयते तात राजा यत्त्वमिहागत: ।कच्चिन्न दीन: सहसा राजा लोकान्तरं गत: ॥ २.१००.६॥
transliteration: kacciddhārayate tāta rājā yattvamihāgata: ।kaccinna dīna: sahasā rājā lokāntaraṁ gata: ॥ 2.100.6॥

translations.english: My dear (brother), now that you have come here, I trust, king Dasaratha is keeping good health and hope, he has not departed prematurely in despondency for the other world.
translations.hindi: उन हाथियों को भागते देख और सेना का कोलाहल सुन श्रीरामचन्द्र जी ने तेजस्वी लक्ष्मण से कहा
